title: Strava Segment Recovery Gap After PRs
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fitness:segment segment_name=* is_pr="yes" recovery_hours=*
| stats avg(recovery_hours) as avg_recovery_hours, count as events by segment_name
| sort - avg_recovery_hours
description: Shows average recovery hours by Strava segment for post-PR recovery.
value: Average recovery hours by Strava segment helps compare post-PR recovery across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `recovery_hours` on `fitness:segment` events and normalize `segment_name` so Splunk can summarize performance by Strava segment.
visualization: Bar chart of average recovery hours by Strava segment.
grandmaExplanation: It blends the average recovery hours for each Strava segment so you can see what works best for post-PR recovery.
